title: Career calibration catchup: promotion readiness prep
content:
Purpose:
This is my scratchpad for a calibration-focused 1:1 with Marcus (manager) before the Q2 promotion cycle runs. Goal is to surface clear evidence, agree gaps, and land on a 90-day plan that makes the decision straightforward. Use this doc to run through talking points, potential counter-questions, and concrete follow-ups we can share with People Ops if we decide to nominate.

Meeting agenda (30 min):
1) Quick status check (3 min) — energy, blockers
2) Promotion calibration framing (5 min) — I’ll state the ask: IC3 -> IC4 promotion in next cycle; high-level rationale
3) Evidence review (10 min) — walk through impact examples and artifacts
4) Gaps and counter-signals (5 min) — solicit manager feedback and risk areas
5) 90-day plan & acceptance criteria (5 min) — agree on deliverables and measurable signals
6) Next steps (2 min) — who writes the packet, timeline for docs, follow-ups

Key opening line (practice):
"Marcus — I wanted to use this time to align on whether the work I’m doing is matching IC4 expectations and to get clarity on missing signals. If we’re aligned, I’d like to aim for nomination in the Q2 cycle; if not, let’s agree a short, focused roadmap so it’s clear by end of Q2"

Impact examples (concise bullets I will present):
- Project: inference-routing v2 (Q4–Q1) — led cross-team design, set latency SLOs, shipped rollout that reduced 95th percentile latency by 18% for targeted routes. Drove design meetings with infra and serving-runtime (see PR #412, rollout notes CONFLUENCE-1234).
- Cost optimization initiative — implemented a cache-key partitioning change that reduced repeated-token spend by ~12% on high-throughput endpoints. Saved estimated $28k/mo on hosted workloads during beta.
- Oncall & incident leadership — primary incident commander for two P1s in last 6 months; reduced time-to-recovery by 30% vs prior baseline by introducing a focused hotfix runbook and postmortem checklist now used by SREs.
- Mentorship & org contribution — mentored 2 new IC2s (weekly pairing, PR reviews), created a lightweight runbook template for new joiners in eng-platform that is referenced by three hiring mentors.

Evidence artifacts to share (links/one-liners):
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infra/pull/412 — feature + perf tests and rollout plan
- Confluence notes: CONFLUENCE-1234 — routing v2 design doc and rollout dashboard screenshots
- Cost estimate spreadsheet: linked in JIRA-PLT-987 (sheet tab: cost-sims)
